test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an initiative by the government for development of the microfinance sector in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana:-**

 
 
• **​**It** **is a government initiative to provide access to** financial services** like banking, insurance, and pension to the **underprivileged sections of society.**
 
• Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana is NOT an initiative by the government for the development of the microfinance sector in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **E-Shakti Initiative:-**

 
 
• It is a program that aims to empower women by digitizing SHGs.
 
• The initiative provides a platform for** SHGs **to connect with banks, access credit, and avail of other financial services.
 
• The program also provides** training to women on digital literacy** and financial management.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana:-**
 
 
• It is a scheme that **provides loans** to micro and small enterprises.
 
• The scheme aims to **promote entrepreneurship **and support the growth of small businesses.
 
• The loans are provided under three categories- **Shishu, Kishor, and Tarun, **based on the stage of business development.
 
 
 
• **India Micro Finance Equity Fund:-**
 
 
• It is a government-sponsored fund that invests in **microfinance institutions **to support the growth of the **microfinance sector.**
 
• The fund aims to provide **equity support **to **microfinance institutions** and promote **financial inclusion.**
